classification.difficultyReason: Find two component areas using symbolic dimensions and add them.

content.prompt: Find the total area of the shaded region below in terms of $x$ and $y$.

spec.description: Tall left rectangle and lower right square share a baseline and an internal vertical partition. Both components are shaded. Ordinary source outlines are rendered black; the requested shaded region uses house light blue.
spec.mathematics: The left rectangle has width y cm and height 2x cm. The right square has width x cm and height x cm. Coordinates describe layout only and introduce no numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: All four dimension labels and the partition remain visible in the question; no areas or answers are supplied.

answer.worked:
Add the areas of the left rectangle and the right square.

$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{left}}&=2x\times y=2xy\ \mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{right}}&=x\times x=x^2\ \mathrm{cm}^2\\A_{\text{total}}&=(2xy+x^2)\ \mathrm{cm}^2\end{align*}$$
